name: The Roll of Names
summary: The Ninth Stair had a roll of names in the purge clerk's hand. Sera wants to find it, and to be watched finding it.

start.summary: The Ninth Stair had a roll of names in the purge clerk's hand. Sera wants to find it, and to be watched finding it.

objectives.text: Find the purge roll in a Shard

loyal.summary: Sera read every name on the Ninth Stair aloud, and you stood there for all of them.

broken.summary: The roll of names went somewhere Sera did not choose. She has not said what she thinks of that.
